propositions: Project-configured code-review criteria merge successfully but do not execute end-to-end, creating a silent failure indistinguishable from no issues found
The code-review runtime must activate project criteria with a fan-in pattern reusing plan-review's stateless runner discriminator without adding workflow DSL fields or hard-coded ids
Project prompt and eval assets must resolve from the reviewed repository snapshot, and missing or malformed assets must raise a located LLMError before model execution rather than silently skipping
Logical project criterion ids must map to sanitized physical prompt ids only when active in code-review routing, and all emitted findings must retain logical ids in their criteria field
Pass 3 must compute repository-effective routing once and apply threshold, blocking posture, and nit-suppression consistently without invoking an LLM
The criteria eval CLI must accept activated logical code-review project ids, reject unknown or ambiguous ids, and dispatch diff cases through the existing code-review path
